title: Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives Coinbase launched an official ChatGPT plugin Tuesday that lets users connect an account and trade bitcoin, other crypto, stocks and derivatives in the chat, approving every order. The official plugin is currently available to U.S. users. This post Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
